sin.name: stack-row-written-outside-the-step
sin.description: Code other than the step's save builds an agent_stack or agent_stack_move row, so a stack changes without the step that decided it (doc 1310 sections 6.1 and 6.5).
sin.rule: Only StoredStepWriter saves the stack and its moves; ReadVersionsWriters bumps an agent's read version. Anything else asks for a step.
